The submission fails the generality requirement in LangChain’s `_edit_args`:

```python
schema = tool.tool_call_schema if tool is not None and tool.name == "send_email" else None
```

This explicitly special-cases the tool name `"send_email"`. Every other tool receives a generic object schema for edited arguments, even if it has a Pydantic argument schema. Consequently, its argument requirements and types are neither exposed in the per-call response schema nor validated by the provider before saving the answer. Simply renaming an otherwise identical tool changes this behavior.

The LangGraph provider uses general `TypeAdapter` validation, but that cannot compensate for the middleware discarding schemas based on tool name. Thus, the combined change does not satisfy the criterion.

FAIL
